name: transformer-fp16
description: One post-norm transformer encoder block (4 heads, d_model 64, ffn 128, ReLU, no dropout) over 16 positions, flattened into a linear head. MSE loss, plain SGD. Forward and loss under FP16 autocast on both sides (torch.autocast(float16) / AIDOTNET_AUTOCAST=fp16); parameters and the SGD update stay float32 (#1549).
